summary.text: Travis Hysell is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Jon Hawkins.
Hysell is a construction worker who, in a Ballotpedia survey, listed affordable housing, healthcare, public education and workers' rights among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Hysell earned a high school diploma from Richfield High School and also attended Utah Valley University.
His career experience includes working as a construction worker.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a construction worker, volunteer and community advocate, and said he experienced homelessness, food insecurity, bullying and foster care as a child.
Hysell said he is running because he believes government should work for families, workers and small businesses.
His three key messages concerned opportunity for every Utahn, accountable and transparent government, and strong communities built through neighbors helping neighbors.
